sql.where:
DELETE_FLAG = 0
AND LOAN_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{loanNo}, '%')
AND BANK_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bankName}, '%')
AND LOAN_TYPE = #{loanType}
AND LOAN_STATUS = #{loanStatus}
AND LOAN_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND LOAN_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TBL_BANK_LOAN
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_BANK_LOAN WHERE LOAN_ID = #{loanId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
INSERT INTO TBL_BANK_LOAN ( LOAN_NO, BANK_NAME, BANK_ACCOUNT, CONTRACT_NO, LOAN_TYPE, LOAN_AMOUNT, LOAN_RATE, LOAN_START_DATE, LOAN_END_DATE, LOAN_TERM, REPAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_ACCOUNT, GUARANTEE_TYPE, GUARANTEE_AMOUNT, CURRENCY, LOAN_STATUS, REMAINING_PRINCIPAL, TOTAL_REPAID, TOTAL_INTEREST, OPERATOR, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_BY, DELETE_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{loanNo}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{contractNo}, #{loanType}, #{loanAmount}, #{loanRate}, #{loanStartDate}, #{loanEndDate}, #{loanTerm}, #{repaymentMethod}, #{paymentAccount}, #{guaranteeType}, #{guaranteeAmount}, #{currency}, #{loanStatus}, #{remainingPrincipal}, #{totalRepaid}, #{totalInterest}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as LOAN_AMOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN LOAN_STATUS = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as TOTAL_REPAID, SUM(CASE WHEN LOAN_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as REMAINING_PRINCIPAL, SUM(CASE WHEN LOAN_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as TOTAL_INTEREST, SUM(LOAN_AMOUNT) as LOAN_TERM FROM TBL_BANK_LOAN WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
